provenance.method: Current Transport for Wales concessionary travel portal checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records the Wales route without deciding individual eligibility.

name: Welsh Disabled Person's Concessionary Travel Card
description: Transport for Wales route for eligible disabled people whose primary address is in Wales to apply for a concessionary travel card.
intended_use: Check current Wales eligibility and application requirements for disabled concessionary travel and companion-card options.
audience_or_context: Eligible disabled people whose primary residence is in Wales.
limitations: Eligibility depends on current Welsh Government/Transport for Wales criteria and evidence.
Free or discounted travel coverage varies by service and route.
cost_or_access_notes: Eligible cardholders can access concessionary travel under the current Welsh scheme; the application portal lists required evidence.
conflicts_of_interest: Transport for Wales is owned by the Welsh Government and operates the official application portal; ND Oracle does not determine individual eligibility.
